Discover Why Guests Return
We can t recommend Hans and Gerna s hospitality enough. It was a perfect escape, and we are already planning our next trip back!
The experience was nothing short of five-star.
If you re looking for a truly unforgettable getaway, look no further than Opperman Safari House . Hans and Gerna are the perfect hosts, and their incredible hospitality made our stay feel like a home away from home.
We were treated to delicious meals three times a day the food was absolutely amazing! In the evenings, we d gather on the stoep with a waterhole right in front of the house to watch the game come and drink, a breathtaking sight you have to see to believe.
Before dinner,  we spent our nights sitting around the fire at the boma, sharing stories and soaking in the peaceful atmosphere. The swimming pool was a fantastic way to relax and cool off during the day.

Frequently Asked Questions
Is Opperman Safari House private-use?
Yes. Opperman Safari House is designed as an exclusive-use private safari house for one group at a time, giving guests a more personal wilderness stay.
Where is Opperman Safari House located?
Opperman Safari House is located at Wildernis Farm No. 957 in the Grootfontein area of Namibia, surrounded by private bushveld and open wilderness.
What is included in a stay?
A stay includes hosted safari services, chef-prepared meals, a private guide, a private game drive vehicle and time to enjoy the house, pool and surrounding nature.
What safari experiences can guests enjoy?
Guests can enjoy private game drives, guided bush walks, bird watching, sundowner moments and wildlife encounters in the Namibian bush.
